CustomField.description: Running count of ContentVersion publications recorded against the current rolling window (design §6.6, L5 predictive daily budget). Incremented only after a SUCCESSFUL publish, by ContentPublicationBudget.record(count). Compared against DAILY_PUBLICATION_BUDGET (1000) by ContentPublicationBudget.canPublish(count) before every conversion attempt in AttachmentPersistQueueable and AttachmentCarrierSweepBatch.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Do not edit manually except to reset the window early. Rolls over to 0 automatically when Window_Start_DateTime__c is more than 24 hours old.
CustomField.label: Publication Count
